bar-button-capability.description: Permissions for the tiny always-on-top toggle button window (js/bar_button.js).

custom-lyrics-overlay-capability.description: Permissions for the custom lyrics overlay window (full-screen, click-through cue renderer — js/custom_lyrics_overlay.js). Sizing/positioning is done from Rust, so no window:* grants are needed beyond the defaults.

main-capability.description: Permissions for the main overlay bar window (js/main.js).

popup-capability.description: Permissions for the popup window (art/title/progress/transport/lyrics — js/popup.js).
